title: Tenure Maximum for Rent Increases on Long-Standing Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreements
content:
**Schedule rule.** The tenure maximum of an existing-customer increase on a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement follows the whole calendar months from the move-in date to the handling date: an agreement in force **84 months or more** is limited to the class's largest single increase less **4 percentage points**, one in force **48 to 83 months** to it less **2 points**, and a younger one to the class's largest single increase. The tenure maximum is the limit percentage before any point is taken off it.

## Tenure maximum by class

| Unit class | Class's largest single increase | Under 48 months | 48 to 83 months | 84 months or more |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Drive-Up Standard | 15% | 15% | 13% | 11% |
| Bluegate Interior Standard | 15% | 15% | 13% | 11% |
| Bluegate Climate Controlled | 12% | 12% | 10% | 8% |
| Bluegate Climate Plus | 12% | 12% | 10% | 8% |
| Bluegate Premier Climate Suite | 9% | 9% | 7% | 5% |
| Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault | 7% | 7% | 5% | 3% |

Months are whole calendar months from the move-in date on the rental agreement record.

## Edges (hypothetical move-in 1 June 2019)

| Handling date | Whole months | Band |
|---|---|---|
| 31 May 2023 | 47 | under 48 |
| 1 June 2023 | 48 | 48 to 83 |
| 31 May 2026 | 83 | 48 to 83 |
| 1 June 2026 | 84 | 84 or more |
